# Preface {.unnumbered}

Welcome to **Cardinal**, a book written in [Quarto](https://quarto.org/docs/books).

This project is built from markdown, executable R code, and a bibliography, so figures, tables, and results stay in sync with the source. Chapters are listed in `_quarto.yml` and rendered together as HTML and PDF.

```{r}
# A small check that the book environment is working
sessionInfo()$R.version$version.string
```
